**Finding submitted: deviation (ASSIGN), fallback cure.**

- **Responsive locations checked:** § 7 ¶ p0042 (clause 10, NONASSIGNABILITY — the only operative assignment provision), the preamble (no successors/assigns language), § 6 termination (no change-of-control trigger or re-pricing right), and the other "assign" hits (p0006, p0009, p0033, p0044 — personnel reassignment and IP assignment of Works, not entity assignment).
- **Why it fails fallback:** clause 10 makes *every* assignment, including Clear Capital's assignment to an M&A successor, subject to RadialSpark's prior written consent; no successor carve-out exists anywhere.
- **Already met:** mutual consent requirement for other assignments, qualified as not to be unreasonably withheld.
- **Cure:** one inserted sentence disapplying the consent requirement for a mutual successor assignment on written notice, preserving the existing consent machinery verbatim for all other transfers. No walk-away issue arose, since there is no Vendor change-of-control termination right to delete.
